name: org.getopencollege/opencollege
title: OpenCollege
description: Federal earnings and debt figures for US college programs, one program at a time.

tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Find college programs by field, school, credential and state. This tool returns up to 10 programs with median earnings four years after finishing, or not published, and each program's page address. Name a field or a school.

field.description: Field name or four-digit field code, for example nursing or 5138.

credential.description: Credential level from 1 to 8: 1 undergraduate certificate, 2 associate's, 3 bachelor's, 4 post-baccalaureate certificate, 5 master's, 6 doctoral, 7 first professional, 8 graduate certificate.

state.description: Two-letter state code, for example CA.

order_by.description: One measure to order by: awards, earnings_4yr, earnings_1yr, debt or name.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: This tool returns every published figure for one program. A program is one credential in one field at one school. The results include median earnings 1, 4, 5 and 7 years after finishing with the cohort and the count, the national figure for the field, the comparison with the Department's medians for high-school graduates, federal loan debt and awards.

opeid6.description: The school's six-digit federal ID (OPEID6), as in the page address.

cip4.description: The four-digit field code, as in the page address.

credential.description: Credential level from 1 to 8: 1 undergraduate certificate, 2 associate's, 3 bachelor's, 4 post-baccalaureate certificate, 5 master's, 6 doctoral, 7 first professional, 8 graduate certificate.

tools.name: compare_programs
tools.description: This tool returns two to four programs side by side. Each figure includes its cohort and count.

programs.description: Two to four programs, each with opeid6, cip4 and credential.

tools.name: find_programs_for_career
tools.description: This tool finds an occupation by name or code, lists the fields the federal crosswalk links to it, and returns up to 10 programs in those fields with their published four-year earnings.

occupation.description: Occupation name or code, for example registered nurses or 29-1141.

state.description: Two-letter state code, for example CA.

tools.name: search_schools
tools.description: Find schools by name, optionally in one state. This tool returns up to 10 schools with their place, sector and number of program pages.

state.description: Two-letter state code, for example CA.

tools.name: get_school
tools.description: This tool returns one school's facts from the institution file and its programs with median earnings four years after finishing, or not published. It lists at most 50 programs.

opeid6.description: The school's six-digit federal ID (OPEID6), as in the page address.

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: Find fields of study by name and return their four-digit codes. This tool returns up to 20 fields.

tools.name: get_field
tools.description: This tool returns the national median and middle-half earnings for one field by credential, the number of programs and how many have a published four-year figure.

cip4.description: The four-digit field code, as in the page address.

credential.description: Credential level from 1 to 8: 1 undergraduate certificate, 2 associate's, 3 bachelor's, 4 post-baccalaureate certificate, 5 master's, 6 doctoral, 7 first professional, 8 graduate certificate.

tools.name: get_earnings_test
tools.description: This tool returns one program's published four-year median, the Department's median for high-school graduates in the school's state and in the nation, and the difference in dollars. This is not an official test result.

opeid6.description: The school's six-digit federal ID (OPEID6), as in the page address.

cip4.description: The four-digit field code, as in the page address.

credential.description: Credential level from 1 to 8: 1 undergraduate certificate, 2 associate's, 3 bachelor's, 4 post-baccalaureate certificate, 5 master's, 6 doctoral, 7 first professional, 8 graduate certificate.

tools.name: search_training_programs
tools.description: This tool finds up to 10 training programs on state lists by field, provider name or state, with their published completion, employment and pay.

field.description: Field name or four-digit field code of the training program.

provider.description: Part of the training provider's name.

state.description: Two-letter state code, for example CA.

tools.name: get_training_program
tools.description: This tool returns one training program from the Department of Labor's file: people served, completion and employment rates, second-quarter pay, length and cost, with their counts.

training_key.description: The training program's key from search_training_programs.

tools.name: get_data_sources
tools.description: This tool returns the files the current release was built from, their release dates and licence notes, and the sources the register holds.
